surviving_state_definition.pixel_state: encoded brightness Y_t(p) < 0.65 * same-frame fixed-support whole-stone median G_t
surviving_state_definition.primitive: full per-frame occupancy fraction with numerator and denominator retained
surviving_state_definition.primary_scalar: mean occupancy over the exact predeclared 17-frame core

threshold_disposition.k_0_65: KEEP as the fixed operational baseline, not a calibrated truth
threshold_disposition.k_0_60_and_0_70: KEEP as sensitivity probes only; no per-stone or per-region tuning

benchmark_evidence.note: Only representative panels are committed; exhaustive generated evidence is reproducible but intentionally omitted from Git.
